prompt:
Create a clean professional fantasy game SPRITE SHEET, exactly eight independent cutout icons, in FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows on a completely TRANSPARENT alpha canvas. Landscape 2:1. No grid lines.
Use polished colorful chunky toy-like 3D illustration, crisp cartoon forms, minimal surface texture, strong bright shapes and material shading. Opaque characters, with anti-aliasing only on their cutout edges. No soft background of any kind, no fog, no glow halos or colored air around icons. The blank transparent gutters should look like empty holes, alpha zero.
Each icon must have generous EMPTY space in its cell: contain its entire silhouette within the central 82 percent width and 82 percent height of that cell. No item crossing the cell boundaries.
Top row left to right:
1. A blond-moustached, small blond-bearded knight in an open silver helmet and blue armor, friendly broad nose, chest-up portrait.
2. A pink bob-haired female archer in a green cloak, chest-up portrait with a partial bow.
3. A small blue bat-winged gargoyle, purple eyes, two horns, cheeky grin, chest-up with compact wings inside the cell.
4. Three wooden arrows together, silver arrowheads, red feather fletching, diagonal flying pose.
Bottom row left to right:
5. A single orange and yellow fireball with a compact attached flame tail; solid illustrated flames, no aura.
6. A friendly orange-haired male giant with sideburns and brown leather vest, chest-up portrait.
7. A squat charcoal-black armored little robot with bright cyan eye slits, rounded steel pauldrons, chest-up portrait.
8. A violet-haired female musketeer under a silver helmet, partial wooden musket, friendly face, chest-up portrait.
Consistent light from upper left. All faces are NEW original faces and proportions. Keep portraits large and readable. There must be exactly eight icons.
Do not draw labels, text, numerals, logos, cards, frames, borders, shadows outside the subjects, colored backgrounds, checkerboards, smoky color, gradient air, floor or display stand. This is an alpha sprite atlas, not eight cards and not a collage with backgrounds. The surroundings and all gutters are fully empty transparent alpha.
